scope: Bounded substantive additions to existing, covered guides using same-day verified official evidence. No new duplicate pages, automatic deal approvals or customer messages.
schedule: 08:30 Europe/Vienna daily, DST-aware with a four-hour maximum queue delay. Existing 12/20 deal quality job no longer competes for blog attempts.
budgets: Existing shared key, credit expiry, USD2 rolling-day/USD38 period limits and no-paid-fallback policy unchanged.
guards: Existing daily editorial result prevents a second draft and fresh source requests.
At most four known official offer pages/five adapter requests; failures retain 24-hour cooldowns.
Fresh source must support the addition AND the unchanged article's offer-specific conditions.
No long verbatim source copying, HTML or arbitrary links in generated prose.
Recheck exact source, feed fingerprint, article bytes and independent review before any article write.
Atomic commit refuses newer remote source/feed/article/daily editorial changes and partial output batches, even with conflict override flags.
Original article, FAQ, photos, URLs, canonical, datePublished and other sitemap entries preserved.
Persistent additions survive complete guide regeneration. Base-copy changes require review instead of silently erasing additions.
Previous additions retained; maximum three additions per guide before a broader human/editorial revision is needed.
No public-success claim until actual article and sitemap bytes match, with a stored public receipt.
